race.comment: COOL STAR (5) looks ideally placed stepping up in distance after a fair effort for sixth at Geelong on a heavy track just over 2 weeks ago. She finally gets a decent draw, and she can be expected to be among the hardest to beat in this. STARRY DESERT (1) was far from disgraced at Donald last start, beaten only 2.5 lengths over 2218m when trying to make all the running. Similar front-running tactics on this circuit would have him right in contention again. ZEACTION (2) has been well supported at his recent outings without delivering, but he did have a genuine excuse last time out. Don't drop him yet. INFER (3) is capable of improving sharply on his modest Wodonga performance and the key this time will be the extra 460m on offer, so he is worth another chance, while TRIORA (6) is another who can bounce back after an unplaced run at Geelong over 2465m, and she can make amends over this more suitable trip.
